13-UNITNING OLTINChI (OXIRGI) BETI (97-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda KO'K yorliqda oq '13', chapida 'Join in the Fun!'.

CHAP USTUN:
21) Kasseta belgisi: qiya 'Ann went to a party.' 'Look at Ann's answers and complete David's questions, then listen and check. Finally, act out the dialogue in pairs.' SURAT: bazmda raqsga tushayotgan er-xotin. DIALOG: David: 1) Did you ......? Ann: Yes. It was a brilliant party! David: 2) ...... were invited? Ann: About a hundred, but I didn't know everyone. David: 3) ...... start? Ann: At seven, but some people didn't arrive till nine. David: 4) ...... do? Ann: We ate great food and listened to music, then we danced for the rest of the evening. David: 5) ...... eat? Ann: Pizza, sandwiches and cake - the usual party food. David: 6) ...... anyone interesting? Ann: Yeah. I met some really interesting people. David: 7) ...... finish? Ann: At about one o'clock in the morning, I think, but I left early because I was working the next day.
• To'q sariq 'Vocabulary Revision Game'.
22) 'In teams, make sentences using the words/phrases below. Each correct sentence gets one point.' Qiya: 'blow whistles, wear scarves, couldn't help admiring, was amazed at, embroidered with, wave flags, stunning show, gave him a hand, joined in with, annually'.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Pronunciation'.
23) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and underline the stressed syllable, as in the example. Listen again and repeat.' PHO-to-graph → pho-TO-gra-pher (namuna, tagiga chizilgan); mu-sic → mu-si-cian; Ja-pan → Ja-pa-nese; pre-pare → pre-pa-ra-tion; hi-sto-ry → hi-sto-rian; ce-le-brate → ce-le-bra-tion.

O'NG USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing (an article about a celebration/event you attended)'.
   TO'Q SARIQ RAMKA: 'When we write an ARTICLE ABOUT A CELEBRATION/EVENT WE ATTENDED, we can divide it into four paragraphs. In the FIRST PARAGRAPH, we write WHAT celebration/event we attended and WHERE and WHEN it took place (place, date/time). In the SECOND PARAGRAPH, we write about the PREPARATIONS before the celebration/event (e.g. costumes, food, etc.) In the THIRD PARAGRAPH, we write WHAT HAPPENED DURING THE CELEBRATION/EVENT. In the LAST PARAGRAPH, we write HOW WE FELT. We normally use PAST TENSES in such pieces of writing.'
24) 'Your teacher has asked you to write a composition about the last birthday party you had (100 - 150 words). First, answer the questions, then use your answers to write your composition.' SARIQ QOG'OZ (bayram qalpog'i): 1 What kind of party did you have? 2 Where and when did it happen? 3 What preparations did you make before the party? 4 What happened during the party? 5 How did you feel at the end of the party?
   SPIRAL DAFTAR 'Plan': Introduction - Para 1: place, date/time of the party. Main Body - Para 2: preparations before the party; Para 3: activities during the party. Conclusion - Para 4: your feelings.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Words of Wisdom': 'Read the sentence. What does it mean?' Ramkada: • 'Old habits die hard.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '97'.

exercises.instructionEn: Ann went to a party. Look at Ann's answers and complete David's questions, then listen and check. Finally, act out the dialogue in pairs.
exercises.instructionUz: Ann bazmga bordi. Ann'ning javoblariga qarang va Davidning savollarini to'ldiring, keyin tinglang va tekshiring. Nihoyat, juftlikda dialogni o'ynang.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBDAN SAVOLNI TOPISh:

  1 'It was a brilliant party!' →
    Did you ENJOY THE PARTY?
  2 'About a hundred' → HOW MANY
    PEOPLE were invited?
  3 'At seven' → WHAT TIME DID IT
    start?
  4 'We ate ... listened ... danced'
    → WHAT DID YOU do?
  5 'Pizza, sandwiches and cake' →
    WHAT DID YOU eat?
  6 'I met some really interesting
    people' → DID YOU MEET anyone
    interesting?
  7 'At about one o'clock' → WHAT
    TIME DID IT finish?

  ⚠ Audio bilan aniq so'zlarni
  tekshiring - boshqa variantlar
  ham to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin.


⚠ 'TILL' = 'UNTIL':

  = ...gacha.
  "didn't arrive till nine" =
  to'qqizgacha kelmadi.


⚠ 'THE USUAL':

  = odatdagi.


⚠ 'THE NEXT DAY':

  = ertasi kuni.

sections.title: Writing (an article about a celebration/event you attended)

exercises.instructionEn: When we write an article about a celebration/event we attended, we can divide it into four paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Biz qatnashgan bayram/tadbir haqida maqola yozganda uni to'rt xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA TUZILIShI (4 XATBOShI):

  1 - QAYSI tadbir, QAYERDA, QAChON
  2 - TAYYoRGARLIKLAR (kostyum,
      ovqat)
  3 - TADBIR DAVOMIDA NIMA BO'LDI
  4 - QANDAY HIS QILDIK

  ⚠ ZAMON: o'tgan zamonlar (past
  simple, past continuous, past
  perfect).


⚠ 'TO ATTEND':

  = qatnashmoq, bormoq.


⚠ 'TO TAKE PLACE':

  = bo'lib o'tmoq.


⚠ 'A PIECE OF WRITING':

  = yozma ish.

points.en: In the first paragraph, we write what celebration/event we attended and where and when it took place (place, date/time).
points.uz: Birinchi xatboshida qaysi bayram/tadbirga qatnashganimiz va u qayerda, qachon bo'lib o'tganini yozamiz (joy, sana/vaqt).

points.en: In the second paragraph, we write about the preparations before the celebration/event (e.g. costumes, food, etc.)
points.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida bayram/tadbirdan oldingi tayyorgarliklar haqida yozamiz (masalan, kostyumlar, ovqat va h.k.)

points.en: In the third paragraph, we write what happened during the celebration/event.
points.uz: Uchinchi xatboshida bayram/tadbir davomida nima bo'lganini yozamiz.

points.en: In the last paragraph, we write how we felt. We normally use past tenses in such pieces of writing.
points.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida qanday his qilganimizni yozamiz. Bunday yozma ishlarda odatda o'tgan zamonlarni ishlatamiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Your teacher has asked you to write a composition about the last birthday party you had (100 - 150 words). First, answer the questions, then use your answers to write your composition. 1 What kind of party did you have? 2 Where and when did it happen? 3 What preparations did you make before the party? 4 What happened during the party? 5 How did you feel at the end of the party?
exercises.instructionUz: O'qituvchingiz sizdan oxirgi tug'ilgan kun bazmingiz haqida insho yozishni so'radi (100-150 so'z). Avval savollarga javob bering, keyin javoblaringizdan insho yozish uchun foydalaning. 1 Qanday bazm qildingiz? 2 U qayerda va qachon bo'ldi? 3 Bazmdan oldin qanday tayyorgarlik ko'rdingiz? 4 Bazm davomida nima bo'ldi? 5 Bazm oxirida o'zingizni qanday his qildingiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
REJA (kitobdagi daftar):

  KIRISh
    1-xatboshi: bazm joyi, sanasi/
    vaqti
  ASOSIY QISM
    2-xatboshi: bazmdan oldingi
    tayyorgarliklar
    3-xatboshi: bazm davomidagi
    mashg'ulotlar
  XULOSA
    4-xatboshi: his-tuyg'ularingiz

  ⚠ 100-150 so'z.
  ⚠ O'TGAN ZAMON.


⚠ 'A COMPOSITION':

  = insho.

structure.modelEn: Last year I had a fancy-dress party for my birthday. It took place at my house on Saturday, 15th March, and it started at six o'clock in the evening.
structure.modelUz: O'tgan yili tug'ilgan kunim uchun maskarad bazmi o'tkazdim. U 15-mart, shanba kuni uyimda bo'ldi va kechqurun soat oltida boshlandi.

structure.modelEn: Before the party, my mum baked a big chocolate cake and I decorated the living room with balloons. I also sent invitations to all my friends and asked them to come in costume.
structure.modelUz: Bazmdan oldin onam katta shokoladli tort pishirdi, men esa mehmonxonani sharlar bilan bezadim. Barcha do'stlarimga taklifnoma yubordim va kostyumda kelishlarini so'radim.

structure.modelEn: During the party, everyone looked great in their costumes. We ate lots of delicious food, played party games and danced to loud music. Then I blew out the candles and everyone sang 'Happy Birthday'.
structure.modelUz: Bazm davomida hamma kostyumlarida ajoyib ko'rinardi. Ko'p mazali ovqat yedik, bazm o'yinlarini o'ynadik va baland musiqaga raqsga tushdik. Keyin shamlarni puflab o'chirdim va hamma 'Happy Birthday' kuyladi.

structure.modelEn: At the end of the party I felt exhausted, but I was really happy. It was the best birthday I have ever had.
structure.modelUz: Bazm oxirida holdan toygan edim, lekin juda baxtli edim. Bu men o'tkazgan eng yaxshi tug'ilgan kun edi.

modelAnswers:
Last year I had a fancy-dress party for my birthday. It took place at my house on Saturday, 15th March, and it started at six o'clock in the evening.

Before the party, my mum baked a big chocolate cake and I decorated the living room with balloons. I also sent invitations to all my friends and asked them to come in costume.

During the party, everyone looked great in their costumes. We ate lots of delicious food, played party games and danced to loud music. Then I blew out the candles and everyone sang 'Happy Birthday'.

At the end of the party I felt exhausted, but I was really happy. It was the best birthday I have ever had.
modelAnswersUz:
O'tgan yili tug'ilgan kunim uchun maskarad bazmi o'tkazdim. U 15-mart, shanba kuni uyimda bo'ldi va kechqurun soat oltida boshlandi.

Bazmdan oldin onam katta shokoladli tort pishirdi, men esa mehmonxonani sharlar bilan bezadim. Barcha do'stlarimga taklifnoma yubordim va kostyumda kelishlarini so'radim.

Bazm davomida hamma kostyumlarida ajoyib ko'rinardi. Ko'p mazali ovqat yedik, bazm o'yinlarini o'ynadik va baland musiqaga raqsga tushdik. Keyin shamlarni puflab o'chirdim va hamma 'Happy Birthday' kuyladi.

Bazm oxirida holdan toygan edim, lekin juda baxtli edim. Bu men o'tkazgan eng yaxshi tug'ilgan kun edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentence. What does it mean?
exercises.explanationUz:
'OLD HABITS DIE HARD.'
  = Eski odatlar qiyin o'ladi.
  MA'NOSI: uzoq vaqt qilingan
  odatni tashlash juda qiyin.


⚠ 'A HABIT':

  = odat.


⚠ 'TO DIE HARD':

  = qiyin yo'qolmoq.

items.answerEn: It is very difficult to stop doing something you have done for a long time.
items.answerUz: Uzoq vaqt qilib kelgan narsani to'xtatish juda qiyin.
